caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical, lidded container rendered primarily in shades of brown, ochre, and beige. The body of the container features decorative relief work, which includes an image of a bird surrounded by foliage and branches with clusters of berries. The upper edge of the container, just below the lid, is adorned with a band of repeating, rounded bead-like shapes. The lid fits perfectly on top, with additional detailing, including concentric circles and a small circular knob at the center. The composition centers the object against a plain, neutral background, emphasizing the shape and ornamentation of the container. The artist’s signature and date ("Chas F. Moss 37.") are present in the lower left corner.
title: Butter Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
